name: Incest Lover ~Mama to Haha no Himitsu~
source:
The protagonist (Tatsuya) lives together with his stepmother Aya... He's an ordinary graduate university student. When he was  still a child, he was told by his father that his mother had died. At present, his father is so busy with work he rarely has time to come home... Along with his stepmother who kept waiting...life moved on. The empty days kept passing until one dark day. They met the beautiful  woman(Sumire) ,who claimed to be a widow  and had moved into the house next door.

Looking from his mother's face, to the woman's...
translation:
主角達也和繼母綾一起生活，是一名普通的大學畢業生。他還是孩子時，父親告訴他母親已經去世。如今，父親忙於工作，很少回家；繼母則一直等待著他……日子就這樣繼續，空虛的每一天不斷流逝，直到某個陰暗的日子。他們遇見了住在隔壁的美麗女人堇。她自稱是寡婦，剛搬進隔壁的房子。

他的目光從母親的臉，移到那個女人臉上……
